text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives member of the central committee of Cuban communist party Varis Cambras.
- Iraq and Jordan discuss land transportation.
- Newly appointed chairman of the United Nations Special Commission (UNSCOM) Richard Butler stresses his desire to open new page with Iraq.
- An oil official says Iraq has consolidated OPEC role in world oil market.
- An Iraqi economic team to visit Syria next week.
- Saddam receives more congratulations on Iraq's national day.
